name: Cat-Cow
description: Alternate between rounding and gently arching the spine from hands and knees.

items.content: Place hands beneath shoulders and knees beneath hips.
Exhale to round the back, tuck the pelvis, and gently lower the chin.
Inhale to tilt the pelvis forward, soften the belly, and draw the chest forward.
Keep elbows straight without locking; move smoothly without forcing the neck or lower back.

stages.name: Cat
stages.description: On hands and knees with arms straight, back rounded toward the ceiling, pelvis tucked and chin gently lowered.

stages.name: Cow
stages.description: On hands and knees with arms straight, pelvis tilted forward, belly lowered slightly and chest lifted forward. Neck follows the curve of the spine without the head being thrown back.
